title: Complex Rehabilitative Power Wheelchairs (Group 3)
description: DME MAC coverage criteria for Group 3 complex rehabilitative power wheelchairs (HCPCS K0848-K0864). Requires severe neurological condition, myopathy, or severe trauma (ALS, quadriplegia, MS), patient unable to safely ambulate or self-propel manual wheelchair within the home, and evaluation by a licensed Physical/Occupational Therapist and ATP.

criteria.name: Severe Neurologic or Myopathic Mobility Limitation (MRADLs)
criteria.description: Documented severe mobility deficit precluding participation in mobility-related activities of daily living (MRADLs) in the home due to severe neurological condition or quadriplegia.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: 23 Based upon the primary health indication of enrollees (Muscular dystrophy – 14%; Polio – 14%; Inclusion body myositis – 9%; Cerebral palsy – 14%; Multiple sclerosis – 9%; Osteogenesis imperfecta – 9%; Other – 32%), participants were estimated to be predominantly Group 3 PWC users.

criteria.name: Specialty Evaluation by Licensed PT/OT and Certified ATP
criteria.description: Documented in-person specialty evaluation by a licensed Physical or Occupational Therapist (PT/OT) in coordination with an Assistive Technology Professional (ATP).
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The beneficiary has had a specialty evaluation that was performed by a licensed/certified medical professional (LCMP), such as a physical therapist (PT) or occupational therapist (OT), or practitioner who has specific training and experience in rehabilitation wheelchair evaluations and that documents the medical necessity for the wheelchair and its special features including seat elevation (refer to the documentation requirements section).

criteria.name: Outdoor-Only Need Without Home Mobility Deficit Exclusion
criteria.description: Power wheelchair requested exclusively for leisure, outdoor recreation, or community transport while patient can ambulate or propel manual chair inside home.
criteria.clinical_intent: Statutory exclusion of mobility equipment for outside-the-home use only
criteria.source_text_excerpt: If a POV will be used inside the home and coverage criteria A-I are not met, it will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.
